title: Chief Executive Order 7 Provisional Constitution Amendment Order 2000

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 7 Provisional Constitution Amendment Order 2000
sections.description:
Short title

ORDER 7 OF 2000
PROVISIONAL CONSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2000
CHIEF EXECUTIVE ORDER
7 OF 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th July, 2000]
No.2-10/99-Min I., dated the 15th
July, 2000.--Whereas, for removal of doubts it is necessary to reaffirm the continuity
and enforcement of the Islamic provisions in the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan as hereinafter mentioned;
1.--(1) This Order may be
called the Provisional Constitution (Amendment) Order, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at once
and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the Fourteenth day of
October, 1999.

ORDER 7 OF 2000
PROVISIONAL CONSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2000
CHIEF EXECUTIVE ORDER
7 OF 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th July, 2000]
No.2-10/99-Min I., dated the 15th
July, 2000.--Whereas, for removal of doubts it is necessary to reaffirm the continuity
and enforcement of the Islamic provisions in the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan as hereinafter mentioned;
2. In the Provisional
Constitution Order No.1 of 1999, in Article 2, after clause (3), the following
clause shall be inserted and shall always be deemed to have been so inserted,
namely:--
"(4) Notwithstanding
anything contained in the Proclamation of the Fourteenth day of October, 1999
or this Order or any other law for the time being in force, all provisions of
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan embodying Islamic
Injunctions including Articles 2", 2A, 31, 203-A to 203-J, 227 to 231 and
260(3)(a) and (b) shall continue to be in force and be deemed to have always so
continued to be in force and no provision as aforesaid shall remain in abeyance
or be deemed to have remained in abeyance at any time.".
